description: Inspect an explicitly authorized target host before planning installation, without installing packages or changing host state.
acceptance: Preflight reports OS, architecture, Docker/Compose availability, filesystem identity, free space, UID/GID, required path ownership, port conflicts, and hardlink feasibility as typed redacted evidence.
Preflight is strictly read-only and uses controlled SSH authority without ambient credentials, agent forwarding, or shell interpolation of untrusted values.
Missing sudo/Docker authority, unsupported platform, ambiguous mounts, insufficient capacity, and unreachable host produce explicit blockers rather than guessed plans.
A disposable remote-host fixture proves healthy and blocked preflight paths without exposing private host identifiers.
